summary: Share of first eligible issued personal auto quotes that receive a known bind event within N calendar days of quote issue.

definitions.quote_identity: quote_id is the business quote; iterations are versions of one quote
definitions.canonical_quote: the first ISSUED and eligible iteration known by the knowledge cutoff, ordered by issue_date then iteration_no
definitions.conversion: EXISTS a BIND event with bind_date in [issue_date, issue_date + window] recorded by the cutoff
definitions.cancelled_binds: a later CANCEL does not negate a bind (v1.0.0)
definitions.version_attribution: product_version of the canonical (first eligible issued) iteration
definitions.maturity: a quote is mature when issue_date + window <= date(knowledge_cutoff); immature quotes are excluded from numerator and denominator and counted separately
definitions.unknown_channel: channel codes without a crosswalk entry are reported as 'unknown', never dropped

rejected.policy_issuance: No certified rule maps policy issuance to quote conversion in v1.0.0

rejected.elapsed_24h: Elapsed-hour windows are not part of the certified algebra

rejected.latest_iteration: Latest-version attribution changes the population grain and is not certified

rejected.exclude_cancelled: No certified rule resolves cancelled binds as of the cutoff

rejected.censored_cohort_report: Censored cohort reporting is a different approved metric that is not installed
rejected.include_immature: Including immature quotes biases the denominator; not admitted

rejected.quote_iteration: Counting iterations changes the population grain

output_grain_rule: output grain equals the requested dimensions
